title: Marmot role
description: A role: a named bundle of permissions you assign to members, teams and service accounts. Write permissions as resource_type:action keys; GET /api/v1/permissions lists them.

permission_keys.description: Permissions as resource_type:action keys, such as assets:view.

permission_ids.description: Permissions by id. Prefer permission_keys, which read the same on every instance.
